comment: A detached session's launch flags survive a resume that omits them: a launch that starts a session records the --copilot-arg values it actually ran with (host-propagated model flags included) and its --driver together with that session's id (per CodeSpace and session tenant), and a later launch that resumes that same session id with no other --copilot-arg and no --driver (like a supervisor's wake after a CodeSpace stop) reuses them instead of the host's defaults. A new session, another session's id, --continue, or explicit flags never inherit the record, and a rejoin of an already running session leaves it alone; the JSON reports what was recalled.
